description.STRENGTHS: Creative; Funny; Adaptable; Inventive; Brainstormer; Sharp-witted
description.WEAKNESS: Annoyed by illogical ideas; Enjoys a bit of chaos
description.IDEALENVIRONMENT: Happy in groups or alone, though avoids melodrama

summary: For you, there is no dogma too holy to be challenged, no thought too basic to be examined, and no rule too vital to be violated, or at the very least, put to the test. Hence, you try to persuade others of the validity of your beliefs by defending them logically, attracting others who share your values.

Your mind is constantly churning out new, exciting, and potentially fruitful ideas. You can grasp the big picture and foretell how things will develop. The ability to trust your gut has served you well. By sifting through a mountain of data and considering each piece of information from a bird's-eye perspective, you may arrive at a novel solution to a problem that no one else thought about.

Occasionally, Challengers may go against their own ideas by arguing the opposite side, if only to obtain a new perspective. You are often fearless and inventive, capable of dismantling and reassembling ideas with remarkable dexterity. You are unfazed by obstacles and go on relentlessly to achieve your aims. In addition, you are not scared to disagree with just about anybody or anything. Most of the time, you Challengers encourage others to find their own solutions to problems and are willing to guide those in need.

Your primary issue is that you lack the capacity to recognize and comprehend interpersonal dynamics. You may find it extremely challenging to gauge people's genuine feelings about you. Besides, one of the hardest things for many of you Challengers is channeling your boundless curiosity and enthusiasm for ideas into tangible results and useful global contributions.

summary: You're an idealist with a huge heart, always looking to build genuine relationships and make a real difference in the lives of others. Sharing your compassion is what gets you up, and you won't settle for anything less than meaningful connections and inspiring change. Overall, you are highly empathetic and socially attuned. However, due to the rarity of the Mediator personality type, individuals like you may struggle to find community and acceptance.

Without a doubt, you have the gift of being driven by your intense emotions – it's like you have an ability that allows you to pick up on all the subtle vibes and energy that others miss. This is a highly developed sixth sense, but with this alertness, you worry about the future. Moreover, you are creative and imaginative, getting lost in daydreams where you may make up your own discussions and scenarios.

You Mediators have a genuine interest in exploring the inner workings of people. You are very self-aware and sensitive to their emotions and experiences, yet also want to connect with others. You can tailor your approach to the specific needs of the individual you are dealing with while also displaying elegance, poise, and a refined demeanor. Your strong intuitive awareness helps you avoid repeating previous blunders and instead create a brighter future. Since you are very attuned to the subtleties of your own mental and emotional moods and rely on them heavily, you might feel the impact of any hurdles more intensely than others.

Usually, your calling involves helping others and relieving their pain because you are able to empathize with it as if it were your own. While it is admirable that you have a heart for helping others, you might quickly burn out if you try to do too much.

summary: You let your wild side take the wheel as you forge ahead on your own path, combining a taste for exploration with your signature creativity and originality. There's no road you can't travel, and no limit to the ideas you can bring to life. Your strength is in seeing what is to come; you can envision how a situation will develop over time and provide sound advice to help others avoid potential pitfalls. Some of history's greatest philosophers and scientists have been Foreseers because they cannot help but ponder life's ultimate riddles.

The majority of the time, you can spot the weakest link in any chain and make accurate forecasts due to your keen intuition. Foreseers take great satisfaction in their ability to think creatively and rigorously. Hence, you are able to predict the behavior of others; the more you know about someone, the more 'boring' they become since they have become so predictable.
